scope: one synthetic development workload on one host

policy.performance_decision: descriptive; independently review the predeclared experiment hypothesis

limits: Both arms use fresh Ruby processes but shared warm OS caches; no OS-cold claim.
Process-until-results includes startup, native load, open, query sequence and source follow-ups; validation follows outside timing.
Warm query timing repeats the same queries on the same opened reader, without source follow-ups.
Peak RSS is this single product process only, excluding kernel cache/controller/install/build costs.
No providers, services, user-task success, Woods comparison, or launch inference.
Initial capture is a checked setup operation, not a repeated extraction benchmark.
Local shared filesystem is not hostile-candidate isolation.
